text:
alex: Quick ask — I'm tuning p95 TTFT alerts for us-west prod. Where's the canonical set of panels + token-rate charts to make a decision? Need traces/logs links too. Trying to avoid chasing the wrong dashboard.
noor: For dashboards start with Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/obs/latency-field-guide?orgId=1 — look for the 'TTFT by model' row. It has p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec split by model and route.
sam: If you need the PromQLs, use:

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket{env="prod",region="us-west"}[5m])) by (le,model))
sum(rate(tokens_served_total{env="prod",region="us-west"}[1m])) by (model)
```

Those map directly to the panels.
alex: perfect — thanks. For alerts, do we notify on absolute ms or % change? Current p95 alert is noisy.
noor: We're moving to a hybrid rule: fire when p95 > baseline * 1.3 AND absolute > 200ms. Baseline is a rolling 7d median. See alert rule and notes: https://alerts.redwood.company/rules/latency-ttft-prod — PR for tuning lives in infra repo.
mike: also check traces: Jaeger link https://jaeger.redwood.company/search?service=inference-prod&tags=region:us-west. Correlate trace id from logs — logs include `trace_id=...` in JSON fields.
alex: Any quick Loki query to find requests that hit the slow path (kv cache miss + high latency)?
sam: Loki snippet:

```loki
{app="inference",env="prod",region="us-west"} | json | trace_id != "" | unwrap latency_ms
| latency_ms > 500
|~ "cache miss|kv_cache_miss"
```

Add `|=` filters for `model=` or `route=` labels when narrowing.
noor: If you want to preview threshold effects I opened a small PR to adjust the p95 rule for Dedicated customers: https://git.company/redwood/infra/pulls/287 — it includes a dashboard snapshot and simulated alert counts. @alex can you review when you have a minute?
alex: reviewing now. One more Q: where do we get tokens/sec by route (not just model)? I want to see traffic patterns to avoid false positives during traffic spikes.
mike: PromQL for route-level tokens:

```promql
sum(rate(tokens_served_total{env="prod",region="us-west"}[1m])) by (route)
```

Grafana panel called 'tokens/s by route' on the same field-guide dashboard. Also use compare view with last 7d.
alex: awesome. I'll run a quick compare across last 7 days and propose thresholds. thanks all :pray:
infra-bot: Reminder: dashboard rollout scheduled 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC — panel ids may change. Use panel titles or saved variables: https://deploys.redwood.company/infra/345
alex: noted — will reference panel names not ids. Closing this thread after PR review.
